result: Audited builder Phase 2 final branch and identified a stale test, response-buffering issue, absent claimed benchmark/demo scripts, and documentation measurement mismatch.
Updated tests/test_config.py to expect pipeline version phase2 and added bounds validation.
Changed reverse proxy upstream response handling to stream and reject once max_response_bytes is exceeded.
20/20 Python tests passed; Python compileall passed; deterministic demo passed; Nginx syntax and end-to-end Nginx integration passed.
Four independent 5000-request runs at concurrency 100 measured 1916.277, 1604.495, 1876.252 and 1888.372 req/s; median 1882.312 req/s; all expected results matched.
Project-only secret scan and Phase-2 TODO/no-op scan passed.
Direct GitHub clone and fresh package-index installation were blocked by terminal DNS/network restrictions; this was recorded rather than hidden.
Phase 2 passes its defined internal 100 percent acceptance gate. Overall Challenge 3 remains in progress.
